title: Signal: R session that points at a cleartext repository
scope: A .Rprofile file that declares an `options(repos=)` value over cleartext.
limitations: It matches an `options(repos=)` value over cleartext in the parsed .Rprofile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .Rprofile that mentions an `options(repos=)` value over cleartext in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
